claim_reviews.strongest_evidence: Exod.3.21-22 anticipates reception; Exod.4.1 begins Moses' direct disbelief objection and 4.2-17 answers it.
claim_reviews.strongest_counterevidence: The call complex has a real retrieval seam at 4.1 if dependency remains explicit.
claim_reviews.recommended_remedy: Retain only with a non-severable commission-dialogue relation; otherwise merge 005+006.

claim_reviews.strongest_evidence: Exod.4.24 opens a lodging/action frame and 4.27 a new Aaron-directed speech/reunion frame.
claim_reviews.strongest_counterevidence: Exod.4.18-31 is one return movement culminating in recognition.
claim_reviews.recommended_remedy: Prefer three-way 4.18-23 / 4.24-26 / 4.27-31 with a parent relation.

claim_reviews.strongest_evidence: Exod.4.27 changes speaker, recipient, location/action, and participants.
claim_reviews.strongest_counterevidence: The scenes jointly complete return and recognition.
claim_reviews.recommended_remedy: At minimum two-way; consider the Hebrew three-way option first.

claim_reviews.strongest_evidence: Exod.6.14-27 is a bounded genealogy; 6.28 resumes commissioning.
claim_reviews.strongest_counterevidence: The genealogy identifies Moses and Aaron at the recommission bridge.

claim_reviews.strongest_evidence: Exod.10.21-29 and 11.1-10 have distinct local forms.
claim_reviews.strongest_counterevidence: Dialogue and impending departure bind the false 10/11 chapter seam.

claim_reviews.strongest_evidence: Exod.13.1 begins a new firstborn/memorial command.
claim_reviews.strongest_counterevidence: Both blocks interpret the departure ritually.
claim_reviews.recommended_remedy: Split 12.43-51 / 13.1-16 with a shared memorial relation.

claim_reviews.strongest_counterevidence: The covenant-code function and T467 guard oppose atomization.

claim_reviews.strongest_evidence: Exod.30.1-10, 11-21, and 22-38 are separately framed procedures.

claim_reviews.strongest_counterevidence: They form the book's command/fulfillment/climax closure.
claim_reviews.recommended_remedy: Preserve the book-close parent; linked children only after boss adjudication.

shared_blind_spots: Neither primary tested retrieval behavior or token pressure.
Both lacked a systematic parent-relation schema.
Neither supplied a consistent rule for technical subprocedures versus larger instruction clusters.
